companyContext: BYD (Build Your Dreams) is a Chinese multinational manufacturer founded in 1995, now the world's leading producer of new-energy vehicles (battery electric and plug-in hybrids), surpassing Tesla in global EV sales since 2024. It also makes batteries, buses, trucks and electronics.
brandContext: BYD Auto is the automotive arm of BYD, selling a line-up of fully electric and Super Hybrid (DM-i) vehicles in France, including ATTO 2/3, Dolphin, Seal, Seal U, Sealion 5, Sealion 7 and Tang.
campaignContext: promotion de la voiture Sealion 5 DM-I

brandVision: Build Your Dreams — BYD's vision is to 'cool the Earth by 1°C' by leading the global shift to electrified, new-energy mobility, combining proprietary Blade Battery safety, DM-i Super Hybrid efficiency and e-Platform 3.0 to make sustainable driving accessible to families worldwide.
brandValues: Innovation, sustainability, safety, accessibility and engineering excellence. BYD stands for technological self-reliance (vertical integration of batteries, motors and electronics), passionate progress (symbolised by the red wordmark), and a customer-focused mission of 'Innovating for a Better Life' through reliable, efficient new-energy vehicles.
